phases.title: MVP
phases.blurb: The smallest adoptable scope: the walker, config loader, the core file, content, and naming primitives, and human plus JSON output.

phases.title: Cross-file and composition
phases.blurb: Cross-file primitives like pair and for_each_dir, the facts system, the when expression language, extends with SRI, and the fix subcommand.

phases.title: Hygiene, portable metadata, byte fingerprints
phases.blurb: Text and Unicode hygiene, encoding and byte-fingerprint rules, portable-name and Unix-metadata checks, and the first content auto-fixers.

phases.title: Bundled rulesets + pre-commit
phases.blurb: One-line adoption through bundled rulesets and pre-commit hooks, with the oss-baseline, rust, node, and monorepo sets landing first.

phases.title: Monorepo scale + plugins v1 + remaining distribution
phases.blurb: Monorepo ergonomics such as changed mode, scope filters, and workspace overlays, the command plugin tier, and the remaining install channels.

phases.title: Agent-era bundled rulesets and output
phases.blurb: The agent-hygiene and agent-context bundled rulesets, plus an agent output format for tools that read alint inside a self-correction loop.

phases.title: New rule kinds for agentic problems
phases.blurb: Heuristic rule kinds markdown_paths_resolve, commented_out_code, and git_blame_age, with the suggest and export-agents-md subcommands.

phases.title: Comprehensive test + bench foundation
phases.blurb: The test and benchmark floor: per-kind coverage, cross-platform CI, an 85 percent coverage gate, and nightly mutation testing.

phases.title: Engine optimization
phases.blurb: Parallel walker, a memory-footprint pass, the per-file dispatch flip, and cross-file fast paths that cut 1M-file runs from minutes to seconds.

phases.title: Case-study coverage push
phases.blurb: Eight case-study-validated rule kinds and the apache/governance and dotnet rulesets, with three pre-release security retirements.

phases.title: LSP + DSL polish
phases.blurb: The alint lsp language server with in-editor diagnostics and quick-fixes, scope generalisation, the commit-validation family, and env interpolation.

phases.title: Real-world coverage expansion (100+ repos) + gap rule kinds
phases.blurb: New kinds file_graph, for_each_match, cross_file, and pair_changed_together, generated_file_fresh mutating mode, a path-confinement security cut, and the php ruleset.

phases.title: Engineering foundations: spec-driven development
phases.blurb: A drift-elimination program on main: schema, facts, and architecture generated and gated, plus a Kani-verified proof of the lexical path-confinement policy.

phases.title: Security and correctness hardening
phases.blurb: Baseline grandfathering mode plus the post-v0.13 security and correctness audit: two spawn-gate RCE bypasses closed, path confinement made symlink-aware, and the fail-loudly contract tightened across output, CLI, and baseline handling.

phases.title: Rule legibility + manifest-derived scoping
phases.blurb: alint explain surfaces a rule's full detail with a docs link and a one-line summary, rules show and list --search browse the catalog offline, and scope_filter gains manifest-derived path scoping so a rule tracks the manifest that declares its members instead of a drifting hand-maintained glob.

phases.title: Stability
phases.blurb: A committed DSL and plugin ABI, a frozen alint-core public API, and a versioned documentation site.

phases.title: Future / backlog
phases.blurb: A wasm plugin kind on a wasmtime host with a stable WIT interface, a filesystem sandbox, and a signed plugin registry, plus a language-agnostic duplicate-code detector, all unpinned from a numbered release until the engine work is scheduled.
